body: is there any workaround to have a working solution please ?

Hello, is there any solution to this?
I have the same problem
@famod are you using Jacoco in your multi module project?

@gsmet We do. We relay report generation to Jenkins though, meaning that we don't use Quarkus' report. In fact, since it caused problems (long time ago), we disabled it.
Also, we are following https://quarkus.io/guides/tests-with-coverage#coverage-for-tests-not-using-quarkustest

The problem goes away if you add a `beans.xml` to that api module (of the reproducer). I suppose otherwise classes in the module are not present in the index that is used by the jacoco extensions.
I suppose generating a `jandex.idx` would work as well.
See also: https://quarkus.io/guides/cdi-reference#bean_discovery

I think at very least, the jacoco guide should mention that relevant classes all need to be indexed.

/cc @geoand

@famod that is very good point!

Would you like to add a note to the docs?
I have very little time ATM but I'll see what I can do. I'll let you know when I have to pass.
I can take if you like, just don't want to take the "credit" since you "fixed" the issue :)
No worries, feel free to take it! :-)
